## Core Commands
- `pip install -r requirements.txt`
- `uvicorn backend.main:app --reload`
- `pytest`

## Critical Rules
- Course: AI002 (Artificial Intelligence Thinking) at UIT.
- Core Focus: Sustainable AI Design Thinking (Reliability, Bias, Robustness, Social Impact, Transparency).
- KISS/YAGNI: Prefer explainable ML models (Random Forest/Prophet) over black-box Deep Learning. Use CSV/SQLite instead of complex databases.
- Git: feature-branch -> PR -> review -> merge.
- Use English for code, commits, and technical docs. User communication is in Vietnamese.
